target.title: Expose legacy cron store doctor lint findings
target.body:
## Summary
- add default-disabled `core/doctor/legacy-cron-store` structured lint findings for legacy cron JSON stores, legacy run logs, quarantined rows, SQLite projection backfills, notify fallback, and stale dreaming payloads
- keep real mutation in the existing legacy `doctor --fix` cron repair path
- wire the new check into the ordered `doctor:legacy-cron` contribution next to the existing WhatsApp crontab check

## Public surface
- No public SDK/plugin/config contract changes.
- Default `doctor --lint` is unchanged; this runs with `--only core/doctor/legacy-cron-store` or `--all`.

## Validation
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/doctor/cron/index.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts` (113 tests)
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/commands/doctor/cron/index.ts src/commands/doctor/cron/index.test.ts src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `pnpm exec oxlint src/commands/doctor/cron/index.ts src/commands/doctor/cron/index.test.ts src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs --check`
- `git diff --check`

## Not completed locally
- `pnpm tsgo:core`, `pnpm tsgo:core:test`, and `pnpm tsgo:test:src` timed out on Windows after 5 minutes without diagnostics.
- Source CLI proof using throwaway `--profile doctor-cron-proof-*` timed out because each invocation rebuilt the dirty-tree runtime; generated proof profiles were removed.
